q1_issues.issue: "in prison" is slotted as (Location (sk_face $x) prison), but the facing is not located in a prison — the prison term is the content of the penalty, not where the eventuality happens.
(MeasureAtMost (sk_face $x) duration 2 year) makes two years the duration of the facing event, whereas the text measures the prison sentence that is faced.
The irrealis force of "would face" is dropped entirely — the consequent carries no status atom, so it reads as an unmarked generic that already holds.

q2_gaps: A penalty/sentence NP as the object of "face" ("face up to two years in prison") — a duration plus a custodial institution describing a prospective punishment rather than the matrix event; neither part has a licensed slot.

Irrealis "would V" in a main clause under a proposed instrument — no status operator covers hypothetical/conditional force; the instruction set mentions "would V" only inside a non-finite complement, where it maps to Future.
notes: The generic-rule routing, the relative clause as rule premises, the definite projections and the framing oblique (Under … sk_bill_1) all follow the instruction set. The penalty NP is where fidelity is lost.
